market_name: Will Trump be impeached by end of 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability jump is accompanied by a concrete news catalyst (scandal, DOJ/House action) versus thin-liquidity drift; scan SPY futures and VIX for any reaction.
time_plan.1h: Compare SPY move to sector-neutral macro moves (rates, dollar) to isolate any political component; if SPY unmoved, downgrade signal further.
time_plan.2h: Look for mainstream wire confirmation of any underlying event; if none, treat the market move as noise.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether the political story has legs into the US session and whether it is shifting midterm-control narratives rather than near-term policy.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate net SPY move vs. baseline; document that impeachment-odds signals have historically low equity beta and mark thesis accordingly.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a House impeachment vote would signal either an emerging scandal or shifting expectations of Democratic House control after 2026 midterms. Historically (2019 Trump impeachment, 2019-20 proceedings), impeachment news produced negligible durable moves in broad US equities because markets treat Senate conviction/removal as the binding event, and that is explicitly NOT required here. Any 12h effect is likely a small, transient risk-off wobble at most, easily swamped by macro/rates flow. The mapping from this specific market to SPY is therefore weak and mostly noise.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check real yields and DXY to see if gold move is macro-driven vs. political.
time_plan.1h: Confirm whether any political catalyst is genuinely escalating uncertainty.
time_plan.2h: Assess if safe-haven bid (gold, JPY, front-end Treasuries) is coherent or isolated.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether the story persists into US trading; if it fades, drop the safe-haven thesis.
time_plan.12h: Compare gold net move to rates/dollar drivers and record that political-odds signal was likely marginal.

predictions.reasoning: Heightened political/constitutional uncertainty can modestly support safe havens like gold, but the linkage is tenuous and gold is dominated by real rates, the dollar, and global macro. A pure impeachment-odds move is unlikely to drive a 12h gold move above a fraction of a percent absent a genuine crisis. Included mainly to flag a weak secondary channel, not a high-conviction call.

evidence_used: Market resolves on a House simple-majority impeachment vote, not Senate conviction or removal
Republicans currently control the House, so a Yes typically requires post-2026 midterm control shift or major GOP defection
Historical precedent (2019 Trump impeachment, Clinton 1998) showed minimal durable US equity market reaction to House impeachment events
12h prediction window and 700bps tradable threshold are demanding for a purely political, non-policy signal
uncertainty_notes: The core weakness: House impeachment (without removal) has repeatedly shown near-zero equity market impact
A probability move could be driven by illiquid Polymarket flow rather than real information
If a move reflected an actual acute scandal or governance crisis, risk-off could be larger, but that is a different, observable event
Direction of any equity effect is ambiguous — markets could shrug or even rally on gridlock expectations

llm_justification.summary: This market tracks the probability of a US House vote to pass articles of impeachment against Trump by end-2026 — explicitly not conviction or removal. A sharp move in that probability is a noisy political signal with historically weak transmission to liquid public markets: prior impeachment episodes produced negligible durable equity moves because the binding event (Senate removal) is excluded and control of the House already limits near-term feasibility. The most plausible, but low-conviction, channels are a small transient risk-off dip in broad US equities (SPY) and a marginal safe-haven bid in gold (GLD). Neither is likely to clear the 700bps tradable threshold in 12 hours absent a genuine underlying crisis. This mapping is weak; direction is best labeled unclear with low confidence.
key_assumptions: Any probability move is not accompanied by a market-moving policy or macro shock beyond the political news itself
Investors continue to treat House impeachment without Senate removal as largely symbolic for asset pricing
Broad ETFs are the cleanest proxies since no single name is directly exposed
failure_modes: The equity/gold move fails to materialize because impeachment odds have essentially no equity beta (most likely outcome)
The information is already public/priced, so the prediction-market move lags rather than leads assets
The proxies (SPY, GLD) are only weakly and indirectly exposed to political-process risk and are dominated by rates/dollar/macro flows
A probability spike is driven by thin prediction-market liquidity, not real information, producing no asset reaction
If a real governance crisis is behind the move, magnitude and direction could differ sharply from this benign-case estimate
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
